translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: K'eesaa Malkki-S'edek'k'a
Ha Malkki-S'edek'k'i, Saleema kaatii, Ubbaappe Bolla S'oossaa k'eesay, Abraahaamo kaatetuwaa wod'iide olaappe simmishshin, aanana gakettiide, Aa anjjeedda.

Abraahaamo bare omoodeedda ubbaappe asiraataa kessiide, aw immeedda; Malkki-S'edek'k'a suntsaw koyro biletsay s'illotetsaa kaatiyaa giyaawaa; k'ay Saleema kaatiyaa I gidiyaa diraw, laa'entso biletsay sarotetsaa kaatiyaa giyaawaa.
Malkki-S'edek'k'aw daaya woy aawuu, woy aw zariyaa payduu baawa; k'ay Aa yeletaw doometsay woy Aa hayk'oo wurssetsay baawa; shin S'oossaa Na'aa malatiide, med'inaw k'eesa gideedda.
Nu aawotuwaa kaappuu Abraahaamo olaan omoodiide, aheeddawaappe asiraataa immeedda Malkki-S'edek'k'i ay keena d'ok'k'u giyaawentto be'ite.
K'eesaa gidiyaa Leewiyaa zaratuu Israa'eeliyaa asaappe, hewenne barenttu gade asaappe haray atto unttunttu Abraahaamo zare gidooppenne, asiraataa akkana mala, higgiyan azazetteeddino.
Malkki-S'edek'k'i Leewiyaa zare gidenna; shin Abraahaamoppe asiraataa akkiide, S'oossay immana geeddawaa naagiyaa Abraahaama anjjeedda.
K'ay anjjiyaawe anjjettiyaawaappe d'ok'k'u giyaawe paluntsenna.
Itti baggana, hayk'k'iyaa Asay asiraataa kessee; shin hara baggana k'ay, hayk'k'enna giide markkattiyaa uray asiraataa kessee.
Hawaadan haasayanaw haray atto, asiraataa kessiyaa Leewiikka Abraahaamo baggana asiraataa immeedda.
Ayaw gooppe, Malkki-S'edek'k'i Abraahaamona gakettiyaa wode, Leewii biro yelettibeenna; shin bare zariyaa Abraahaama gulbbatan de'ee.
Israa'eeliyaa asaw higgii Leewiyaa
zeretsatuwaa k'eesetetsaa baggana imetteedda. He k'eesetetsaa kiitay balay baynnawaa gidooppe, Aaroonawaa mala gidennaan Malkki-S'edek'k'a mala hara k'eesay suntsettanaw ayaw koshshii?
Ayaw gooppe, k'eesetetsay laamettiyaa wode, higgiikka k'ay laamettanaw koshshee.
Ha yewuu haasayetteedda uray hara zarii; Aa zariyaappe ooninne yarshshiyaasaan k'eesaadan ootsibeenna.
Nu Goday Yihudaa zariyaappe yeeddawe eretteeddawaa gidiyaa diraw, Muse k'eesatuwaabaa haasayiidde, he zariyaabaa ayinne haasayibeenna.
Kiristtoosi Malkki-S'edek'k'a Mala K'eesaa
Malkki-S'edek'k'a mala hara k'eesay yeeddawaa gidintto, hawe aad'd'iide erettanawaa.
I asaa higgiyaaninne wogaan k'eesa gidibeenna; shin wurenna de'uwaa wolk'k'aan k'eesa gideedda.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa Mas'aafay,
yaagiide markkattee.
Beni de'iyaa higgii laafanne maaddennawaa gidiyaa diraw atteedda.
Ayaw gooppe, Muse higgii ayaanne balay baynnawaa ootsanaw danddayenna; k'ay nuuni Aa baggana S'oossaakko shiik'ana giide nashechchaan naagi utteedda ubbaappe aad'd'iyaawe yeedda.
Hewaa bollan k'ay S'oossaa c'aak'uukka de'ee; haratuu k'eesa gideedda wode, hewaa mala c'aak'uu baawa.
Shin Yesuusi c'aak'uwaan k'eesa gideedda; S'oossay Aa,
yaageedda.
Hewaa diraw, Yesuusi ubbaappe aad'd'iyaa c'aak'k'oo waase gideedda.
Kase k'eesatuwaa payduu c'ora; ayaw gooppe, unttunttu ootsana oosuwaa hayk'uu diggeedda.
Shin Yesuusi med'inaw de'iyaa diraw, Aa k'eesetetsay laamettenna.
Hewaa diraw, I unttunttu gishshataw gaannatanaw med'inaw de'iyaa diraw, S'oossaakko bare baggana yiyaawantta ubbatuwaa ashshanaw danddayee.
Nuw giigiyaa hawaa mala, k'eesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuu de'anaw koshshee; I geeshsha; aan geniinne kad'etsiyaabay baawa; nagaranchchatuwaanna I gakettenna; k'ay d'ok'k'a saluwankka I bonchchetteedda.

Hara k'eesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappatuwaadan, I koyro bare huup'e nagaraw yarshshiide, k'ay guyyeppe asaa nagaraw hachche hachche yarshshanaw koshshenna; I barena yarshsheedda wode, laa'entsennaan itti gede yarshsheedda.

Ayaw gooppe, Muse higgii daaburanchcha asaa k'eesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuwaa ootsiide suntsee; shin S'oossay immana giide c'aak'k'eedda higgiyaappe guyye yeedda k'aalay med'inaw balay baynnawaa, S'oossaa Na'aa suntsee.

footnotes.text: Leewiyaa: Ha suntsaa s'eesettiyaawanttu k'eesatuwaappenne unttuntta maaddiyaawanttuppe dooretteeddawantta.
